reason: I'm worn out juggling work and Mum, so the tiredness bit appeals. But I've never heard of Mëva and I can't find a single review of it on Trustpilot or Amazon, so I'd be paying for a brand with no track record.
objection: I don't know if I'd like the taste or texture, and nobody I can see has tried it yet. The sugar and glucose syrup put me off too, even if the taste promise is there.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews from women my age who have taken it for a month, saying what the taste and texture are actually like.
